name: TemporalBench
intro: TemporalBench是一个细粒度视频时间理解基准，包含2000条人工细化的正字幕和10000组由词级或事件级负字幕构成的问答，并扩展到1574段长视频。
org: University of Washington, Allen Institute for AI
eval_feature: 细粒度时间负例, 短视频与长视频, 反文本捷径
scale: 2000条视频字幕，10000组问答，1574段长视频
eval_feature_en: Fine-grained temporal negatives, short and long video, anti-text-shortcut metric
intro_en: TemporalBench is a fine-grained video temporal-understanding benchmark with 2,000 human-refined positive captions and 10,000 QA pairs built from word- or event-level negatives, plus a 1,574-video long-form extension.
scale_en: 2,000 video captions, 10,000 QA pairs, and 1,574 long videos
drawio_review_note: Aligned with TemporalBench arXiv:2410.10818 Sections 3-5 and official TemporalBench project page. TemporalBench samples about 300 validation or test clips from each of seven diverse video sources to obtain roughly 2,000 clips. Optical flow removes mostly static clips, PySceneDetect removes clips with multiple scene changes, and clips longer than twenty seconds are excluded; audio is removed during annotation. Qualified AMT master workers pass three probe-caption tasks with two examples and write detailed positive captions, which the authors refine; FineGym's existing detailed action descriptions are reused. GPT-4o, Gemini-1.5-Pro, and Llama-3.1-405B generate up to nine word-level and six event-order negative captions from three examples. Authors review the candidates as multiple-choice QA, leaving 2,000 human-annotated captions and 10,000 video QA pairs. To remove the centralized-answer shortcut, each multi-choice item is decomposed into several binary questions. Short-video evaluation reports Binary Accuracy and the stricter Multiple Binary Accuracy across sources, with text-only and single-frame controls. Long-video evaluation samples non-overlapping clips from one source video, crops the enclosing segment, concatenates their positive captions, replaces one clip caption with a negative for each distractor, and reports BA and MBA over 1,574 long videos.
